messages:
Fix case-sensitive SKU lookup in catalog

Catalog.find() upper-cased SKUs when storing but not when looking them
up, so a product typed in lower case (e.g. lb-220) was reported as
unknown even though the same SKU in capitals worked.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Ship free at exactly the free-shipping amount

shippingCost() charged for shipping when goods came to exactly
€50.00, because it compared with a strict '>' instead of '>='. The
README says free shipping applies from €50.00 "or more".

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Round line VAT half up instead of down

lineVat() truncated with Math.floor instead of applying the project's
half-up rounding rule, undercharging VAT by a cent on lines like
€1.99 at the standard rate (43c instead of 44c). Now delegates to the
shared percentOf() helper, as shippingVat() already does.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
